name: Alabama

context: AL 340: cover crop purposes include reducing sheet, rill, and wind erosion.
AL 329: use current wind and water erosion prediction technology to set the residue amount needed.
cover_rules: AL 340: maximize combined canopy and surface residue cover to a minimum of 90-percent cover during potentially erosive wind or rainfall.
AL 340: cover crop termination may not be earlier than 35 days before the planned cash crop planting.
seeding: AL 342: bahiagrass 40 lbs per acre; common hulled bermudagrass 10 lbs per acre, planting depth ¼ - ½ in.
AL 342: switchgrass 10 lbs. PLS per acre, planted ¼ in deep; do not mow below 8 – 12 inches.
pasture: AL 512: bahiagrass 15 - 20 lb seeding rate, planted Mar - Jul 15 central; adapted to sandy soils and tolerates drought.
AL 512: hulled bermudagrass seed 5 lb per acre, planted Mar 15-Jul 15 central.

coverPlant.text: AL 340: cereal rye, oats, triticale and wheat are planted Sep 15 – Nov 1 in central Alabama; Sep 1 – Nov 1 in the north.
